origins.section: A Plain HashMap Shared by Writers Loses Entries and Can Hang
A Synchronized Wrapper Makes Each Call Atomic, Not a Sequence of Calls
A Thread-Safe Map Guards Its Entries, Not the Objects Stored in Them
CopyOnWriteArrayList Copies the Whole Array on Every Write

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-warmup-distinct-keys: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-warmup-distinct-keys: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-warmup-distinct-keys: The page says different threads share the map's table and 'threads that link entries or resize at the same time overwrite each other's work. Entries vanish without an error', and the runs show size() well under 100000.
recorded.prompt:q-stock-reserve: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-stock-reserve: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-stock-reserve: The page says merge/compute 'read and write in one call, and both maps run each of them atomically. Make every read-modify-write on a shared map one of those calls.'
recorded.prompt:q-scanner-serials: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-scanner-serials: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-scanner-serials: In the 'computeIfAbsent, ArrayList' case the page shows 602 lost and says 'The map's atomicity covers finding or creating the entry, and ends before add runs.'
recorded.prompt:q-gateway-lists: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-gateway-lists: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-gateway-lists: The page says CopyOnWriteArrayList 'fits a list of listeners or routes, read on every event and changed at deploy time. An event buffer that grows on every request belongs in a synchronized list or a queue.'

recorded.prompt:q-warmup-distinct-keys:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-warmup-distinct-keys:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-warmup-distinct-keys:a: The page says 'different threads still share the map's table' even with distinct keys, and its runs with keys that never repeat lose entries.
recorded.prompt:q-warmup-distinct-keys:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-warmup-distinct-keys:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-warmup-distinct-keys:b: The page describes threads that 'link entries or resize at the same time', so puts from different threads overlap rather than finishing one at a time.
recorded.prompt:q-warmup-distinct-keys:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-warmup-distinct-keys:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-warmup-distinct-keys:d: The page says 'One thread alone keeps every distinct key, colliding or not', so a collision does not make one key replace another.
recorded.prompt:q-stock-reserve:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-stock-reserve:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-stock-reserve:a: The page says 'Moving to ConcurrentHashMap changes nothing while the code still makes two calls', and its ConcurrentHashMap get-then-put run counted only 37417 of 80000.
recorded.prompt:q-stock-reserve:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-stock-reserve:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-stock-reserve:b: The same line, 'Moving to ConcurrentHashMap changes nothing while the code still makes two calls', refutes it, and the 'two threads read 41, both write 42' example shows that up-to-date reads do not prevent the race.
recorded.prompt:q-stock-reserve:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-stock-reserve:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-stock-reserve:d: The page says 'The wrapper's lock is the wrapper object itself' and 'Locking anything else ... excludes nobody.'
recorded.prompt:q-scanner-serials:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-scanner-serials:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-scanner-serials:b: The page says 'computeIfAbsent runs the factory at most once per missing key and gives every caller the same list.'
recorded.prompt:q-scanner-serials:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-scanner-serials:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-scanner-serials:c: The page says the map's atomicity 'ends before add runs', and the same setup lost serials.
recorded.prompt:q-scanner-serials:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-scanner-serials:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-scanner-serials:d: The page says 'A Thread-Safe Map Guards Its Entries, Not the Objects Stored in Them', and that a value threads change after they get it 'needs its own thread safety'.
recorded.prompt:q-gateway-lists:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-gateway-lists:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-gateway-lists:b: The page says 'The cost of an add grows with the list' (100000 adds took 1110 ms), and that a buffer growing on every request belongs in a synchronized list or a queue.
recorded.prompt:q-gateway-lists:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-gateway-lists:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-gateway-lists:c: The page says each write copies the whole array and adds are the expensive operation (1110 ms against 2 ms), and that routes changed at deploy time suit CopyOnWriteArrayList.
recorded.prompt:q-gateway-lists:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-gateway-lists:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-gateway-lists:d: The page says 'Reads and walks use whichever array was current, with no lock' and 'a walk never waits'.
